name: calathea
note: Round leaves banded with silver along the veins.
enters: Low in the bed, in front
grows: The rosette opens leaf by leaf

name: monstera
note: A broad heart split from the margin and pierced along the midrib.

name: strelitzia
note: Long paddles in a fan, torn by the wind, and one crane flower on its own stalk.
grows: Paddles rise in turn, and the flower opens last

name: palm
note: Pleated, nearly round fans on long toothed stalks.
grows: Stalks extend, then each fan opens

name: alocasia
note: Dark arrowheads with scalloped edges and silver veins.
grows: Stalks rise, and leaves tilt open

name: staghorn
note: Shield fronds over a hanging basket, and broad antler fronds that fork into rounded lobes.
grows: Antler fronds unfold one by one

name: philodendron
note: Glossy hearts, some streaked with lime, on a trailing stem.
grows: The stem lengthens downward, and hearts unfold

name: adansonii
note: Small leaves full of oval holes on a wandering stem.
grows: The stem extends, and leaves unfold behind the tip

name: bauhinia
note: Two-lobed butterfly leaves on a slender branch, and orchid-like flowers with fine curving stamens.
grows: The branch extends, leaves open, and flowers come last

name: lychee
note: Drooping leaves of glossy leaflets and a hanging cluster of pebbled rose-red fruit.
grows: The limb extends, leaves unfold, and the fruit drops last

name: mango
note: Loose clusters of smooth leathery leaves, and mangoes ripening from green to gold.
grows: The limb extends, clusters open, and the fruit swells last

name: frangipani
note: Thick, smooth limbs that end blunt, spiral rosettes of broad leaves, and pinwheel flowers warming to yellow at the heart.
grows: The limb extends and forks, rosettes open, and flowers come last
